text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...No way, did I gain weight? I haven't 
lowered the quality of my training at 
all..."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The only thing I can think of... is her 
diet? We've been trying out a few new menu 
items lately, so...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...The real race is doing it before it 
starts to show. Besides, if we're doing 
this, then—

Royce and Royce called me over, and we 
ended up filming a video on the fly—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Wah! Is the camera rolling already?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"And so—once again, I'm Royce and Royce♪ 
In today's video—we're tackling a diet 
project!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Weight management is important for 
entering races too. But sometimes, when 
I'm alone, I feel like giving up..."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
So today, I'd like to ask for everyone's 
help!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Please cheer for Royce as she works hard 
on her diet!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Alright! With this, the staging for 
'Royce-chan, admirably doing her best for 
her dream' is perfect.
choice_data_list: Why would anyone make a video like this?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Because it's the absolute worst! It's 
shocking enough just gaining weight, but 
now I have to waste time and effort 
burning it off!?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm making videos of my diet 
journey. Wouldn't it be awesome if it 
inspired other girls who are dieting too?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Sharing your struggles fosters a strong 
sense of camaraderie. Plus, if the results 
prove effective, it'll boost my reputation 
as a diet expert!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
This is where I get to show off my 
self-producing skills by turning a 
negative into a positive! Alright, let's 
start by filming a running video!

And so, Lois and Lois succeeded in her 
diet while creating the PR video. I 
couldn't help but admire her skill.
